sections.text_helper: Section 39.13 "DCMIPP interrupts" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1897.
sections.section_content:
This section describes the DCMIPP interrupts, and more globally, the features that are
related to real-time, namely:
• Free-running: DCMIPP can run without CPU involvement
• Shadow registers: relieve timing constrains from the software
• Interrupts: source of interrupt
• Event pins: to drive external IPs, like a DMA
